channel.description: The week in rates, credit and the economy, as of Friday's close.

item.title: Last Print: Higher, for real.
item.description: The 2-year Treasury yield rose 37 bp on the week to 4.88% and the 10-year 29 bp to 5.15%. The 10-year real yield rose 28 bp. October PPI rose 0.3%. Retail sales are due Nov. 17.
